scope: mechanical validate gate for decisive rejection, using invented ledger data

independent_review.reviewer: native read-only development agent, not an independent field evaluator
independent_review.crossing_interval_false_green: A lower-CI success threshold of 0.1 and an interval [0.05, 0.4] could satisfy a textual rejection although the upper CI crossed the threshold.
independent_review.overlapping_predicates_false_green: A rejection test duplicating lower_ci >= 0.1 made both cumplido and incumplido ready for interval [0.15, 0.4].
independent_review.preexisting_generic_success_configuratio: A field criterion that declares estimate >= 0.1 can still accept a favorable point estimate with crossing CI. The food protocol instead requires lower_ci >= 0.1; the existing gate regression blocks a crossing CI when that criterion is declared.

controls: field rejection rejects simulation-only baseline and result
decisive rejection requires prior structured threshold and measured effect
field rejection for >= T requires upper_ci < T at the same T
field rejection for <= T requires lower_ci > T at the same T
crossing interval blocks decisive rejection and permits no_demostrado
adverse interval with matching preregistered rejection test can pass the mechanical gate
zero sample size blocks field rejection
simultaneous success and rejection predicates block both decisive verdicts

checks.command: uv build --wheel; clean offline wheel installs and scripts/clean_smoke.py on CPython 3.11.15 and 3.12.3
checks.result: both passed: 29 packages compatible, 9 phases, 14 CLI commands and 14 MCP tools

limitations: All sources, measurements, baselines, result effects, designs, and intervals in the tests are synthetic declarations.
A passing gate does not authenticate field provenance, measurement, human authority, causal attribution, costs, or harms.
The structured rejection schema covers one scalar threshold and uncertainty interval; distinct critical adverse event rules require external assessment.

The generic gate evaluates the success statistic actually declared. It does not infer the food protocol's required lower_ci >= 0.10 from a field label; the R-F criterion must be registered and independently checked before data collection.
No food-chain intervention or comparative methodology trial was executed by this probe.
